nodes.label: DocPad system architecture (Next.js 16 on Vercel + one Supabase project)
nodes.rationale: The browser does most of the work; client components query Postgres directly via supabase-js. The Next.js server only handles things needing a secret (AI, WhatsApp, SNOMED, FHIR export, backups). No staging, queue, cache tier or warehouse.

nodes.label: Row Level Security as the real security boundary
nodes.rationale: Because the browser writes to the database directly with the user's JWT, RLS policies (476) rather than app code enforce access; tenant key on every row.

nodes.label: Single shared schema with row-level tenancy (hospital_id)
nodes.rationale: Caller's hospital resolved auth.uid() -> practitioners.user_id -> practitioners.hospital_id; child tables scoped via parent; global reference tables have no tenant column.

Request path: finalizing a prescription
nodes.rationale: Safety checks and the record lock live in Postgres triggers, not in the app, so a request that skips the UI still hits them. The WhatsApp API route reads the recipient from the database, not the request body.

nodes.label: zz_audit_row trigger / append-only audit_logs
nodes.rationale: Writes old and new JSONB to audit_logs on 83 tables; log_phi_read() records reads inside RPCs.

nodes.label: One OLTP Postgres store, no analytical store
nodes.rationale: All data lands in one Postgres; dashboards call ~30 get_* RPCs on live tables. 'ETL' = one-off reference loaders, trigger chains, AI extraction calls.

nodes.label: Billing trigger chain (charges derived, not entered)
nodes.rationale: Clinical events create charge_items via triggers (trg_auto_consultation_charge, trg_investigation_to_billing, trg_ipd_treatment_to_billing, trg_auto_bill_consumable) which roll up to invoice_line_items and invoice totals (aa_invoice_line_math, zz_recalc_invoice_from_line/payment).

nodes.label: MAR / nursing task / MEWS trigger chain
FHIR-shaped billing model (ChargeItemDefinition -> ChargeItem -> Invoice)
nodes.rationale: Unit price is snapshotted onto the charge item at creation so later price changes do not rewrite history.

ECG digitization pipeline (orient, crop, ink isolation, adaptive threshold, extract, smooth, slice, flip)
nodes.rationale: HSV ink mask drops paper and pink grid; adaptive gaussian threshold handles shadows/creases; column-wise median Y with NaN interpolation; bottom 20% treated as Lead II rhythm strip; Y flipped so higher voltage plots upward.

nodes.label: Savitzky-Golay smoothing (window 31, order 3, SAVGOL_WINDOW)
nodes.rationale: Larger window is smoother but loses sharp QRS peaks.

ABDM Edge Functions: flow and structure
getGatewayAccessToken
nodes.rationale: Uses client_credentials against gateway sessions; token cached in isolate until ~1 min before expiry.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM bundle + RSA-OAEP-256 key wrap envelope
nodes.rationale: FHIR bundle canonicalised, encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key wrapped with recipient RSA public key; passthrough mode skips encryption for sandbox/alternate contracts.

nodes.label: Configurable ABDM_*_PATH env vars
nodes.rationale: Default REST paths are conventions; NDHM sandbox/production paths differ, so every gateway path is overridable by env var.
